text: A channel of bandwidth B can carry at most how many symbols per second without intersymbol interference?
explanation: Nyquist's 1924 result: the maximum symbol rate is 2B baud. A channel passing frequencies up to B cannot produce transitions faster than a sinusoid at B, and one cycle contains two independent excursions. Combined with bits-per-symbol, this gives C = 2B log2(M) — correct but incomplete, since it places no limit on M.
